description.value: Bella Villa is an off-highway, lakefront motel situated on the shores of Osoyoos Lake in the southern Okanagan. Units feature fully equipped kitchens, and guests can use a grass courtyard with outdoor dining and gas barbecues. The quiet, beach-adjacent setting would appeal to cyclists seeking a relaxed base for exploring the Okanagan's wine-country roads.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the business is an active lakefront motel in Osoyoos, BC, and the phone number (1-888-495-6751) matches OSM exactly. The website lists amenities (kitchen, AC, cable, high-speed internet, courtyard, barbecues) but makes no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific services. The copyright footers read '2006-20' and '2006-13', suggesting the site has not been actively maintained, which limits the reliability of amenity claims.
concerns: Website copyright footers read '2006-20' and '2006-13', suggesting the site has not been actively maintained; amenity information may be outdated.
OSM address lacks city and postal code; website confirms Osoyoos, BC but provides no street address for cross-check.
Website content is very thin (under 1,200 bytes fetched), so many amenity fields cannot be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The motel is a legitimate lakefront accommodation in Osoyoos but neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike procedure) can be confirmed from the website. Direct outreach is needed before a WWC listing can be justified.

wow_evidence: off-highway, lakefront motel situated on the shores of Osoyoos Lake
